questions.question: Name the father of microbiology. a) Louis Pasteur b) Antonie van Leeuwenhoek c) Robert Koch d) Paul Ehrlich
questions.solution_html:
• Answer
  • Contributions of Robert Koch
  • Robert Koch is known as the Father of Medical Microbiology. His major contributions include
  • • Established the germ theory of disease.
  • • Identified Bacillus anthracis as the cause of anthrax.
  • • Discovered Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the causative agent of tuberculosis.
  • • Identified Vibrio cholerae as the causative organism of cholera.
  • • Developed pure culture techniques.
  • • Introduced staining methods and solid culture media.
  • Koch’s Postulates
questions.source_exam: Official Model Question Paper (FYUGP 2024

questions.question: Select the correct covering found in protozoa like Paramecium: a). Cell wall b). Capsule c). Pellicle d). Cuticle
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: c) Population of cells arising from a single cell
  • The pure culture should produce the same disease when inoculated into a healthy host.
  • Stationary Phase
  • • Nutrients become limited.
  • • Waste products accumulate.
  • • Rate of cell growth equals rate of cell death.
  • Spread evenly using a sterile L-shaped glass spreader.
  • Meiosis
  • Reduction division producing haploid spores.
  • Methods of Sexual Reproduction
  • A. Planogametic Copulation
  • Fusion of motile gametes.
  • Example: Lower fungi
  • B. Gametangial Contact
  • Male and female gametangia come into contact and nuclei migrate through a fertilization tube.
  • Example:Pythium
  • C. Gametangial Copulation
  • Entire gametangia fuse and their contents unite.
  • Example:Rhizopus
  • D. Spermatization
  • Non-motile male cells (spermatia) fuse with receptive hyphae.
  • Example: Rust fungi
  • E. Somatogamy
  • Fusion of ordinary vegetative cells.
  • Example: Mushrooms
  • Importance
  • • Generates genetic variation.
  • • Helps adaptation.
  • • Produces resistant spores.

questions.question: Describe the role of moisture in spoilage of stored cereal grains.
questions.solution_html:
• Moisture plays a major role in grain spoilage.
  • Effects of High Moisture
  • • Promotes growth of moulds and bacteria.
  • • Increases respiration of grains.
  • • Causes heating and caking.
  • • Encourages insect infestation.
  • • Leads to production of mycotoxins such as aflatoxins.
  • • Reduces shelf life and quality.
  • Prevention
  • • Maintain grain moisture below 13–14%.
  • • Store in dry and well-ventilated conditions.
  • Essay
